name: Chang Seil
source:
Assistant producer who works under producer [url=/c91643]Seungyeon Shin[/url], helping her with all kind of tasks. Has many contacts among the contestants so they talk to each other casually. 

His messenger bag contains a notebook that he uses to scribble on from time to time.

[Edited from English Official website]
